findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 542C
findings.details: [OCR CORRECTION REQUIRED] 字源 PDF p. 96 (printed p. 84), 听 headword reading line and immediately preceding 唏 entry: provisional corpus OCR assigns the printed leading yǐn and following tīng under the wrong line/neighboring headword (raw excerpt has preceding “ī …” then “听 yǐn … tīng”). The original scan visibly prints 听 yǐn on its headword line and tīng beneath. Propose a page-bound source-layer correction after producer verification; no corpus repair has been applied here.
